faq.q: Can I use my logo as a watermark?
faq.a: Yes. Switch to "Image Watermark" mode and upload your logo image (PNG with transparency works best).

faq.q: Will the watermark be hard to remove?
faq.a: A well-placed, semi-transparent watermark provides basic protection. For stronger security, consider tiling multiple watermarks or using a more opaque setting.

faq.q: Can I adjust watermark position precisely?
faq.a: Currently we offer preset positions. Free positioning is planned for a future update.
